assets.name: rank_ribbon
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable illustrated ranking plaque for volleyball video headings and full-screen transitions. Primary request: a wide horizontal cream paper ribbon with a thick playful navy ink outline, mint and coral folded ends, and one small yellow volleyball tucked at the outer left end. Composition: 3:1 landscape asset, clean flat pale cream center taking at least 70 percent of the width and 55 percent of the height, genuinely empty center for Chinese ranking text added later in code, minimal graphic flourishes only at the outer edges, generous padding. Style/medium: premium contemporary hand-drawn sports editorial illustration, confident imperfect deep navy ink contour and subtle screenprint grain, energetic and professional, not childish clip art. Color palette: deep navy #0D1628, cream #FFF6DF, warm yellow #FFC646, mint #55E7C7, restrained coral #FF738E; matches the existing volleyball video design. Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no solid rectangle, no checkerboard. Constraints: no text, no letters, no digits, no logos, no watermark. Entire artwork visible with clear margins.
